description: Unit tests for the SPDY protocol implementation in the quiche library, including priority and stream ID validation, and data IR handling.

classes.name: SpdyStreamPrecedence
classes.description: Represents the precedence of a SPDY stream, supporting both SPDY3 priority and HTTP/2 weight-based precedence.

classes.name: SpdyDataIR
classes.description: Represents SPDY data frame data, including data copying and padding management.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const SpdyStreamPrecedence&)
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of SpdyStreamPrecedence to an ostream.

methods.name: ClampSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Clamps a given priority to valid SPDY3 priority range.

methods.name: ClampHttp2Weight
methods.description: Clamps a weight value to valid HTTP/2 stream weight range.

methods.name: Spdy3PriorityToHttp2Weight
methods.description: Converts SPDY3 priority to HTTP/2 weight.

methods.name: Http2WeightToSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Converts HTTP/2 weight to SPDY3 priority.

methods.name: IsValidHTTP2FrameStreamId
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is valid for a given HTTP/2 frame type.

methods.name: ParseSettingsId
methods.description: Parses a numeric setting ID into a known settings enum.

methods.name: SettingsIdToString
methods.description: Converts a settings ID enum to its string representation.
